gloss: the farthest reaches; the ends (of the earth)

definitions.gloss: the farthest reaches; the ends of the earth; the most remote place
definitions.explanation: The most distant, remote point of a region or territory. Often carries a poetic or dramatic tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最果|さいは}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I aim for the ends of the earth.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最果|さいは}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}だ。
examples.english: This is the most remote place in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最果|さいは}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{灯台|とうだい}→灯台：04560_toudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねて→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧、{地|ち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わいた。
examples.english: When I visited the lighthouse at the northernmost tip of Hokkaido, I truly felt like I had come to the edge of the world.

notes:
{最果|さいは}て combines ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most, utmost) with {果|は}て (end, extremity). It has a literary, evocative quality and is often used in travel writing, poetry, and dramatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最果|さいは}て (the ends of the earth)
- {最果|さいは}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち} (the most remote land)
- {最果|さいは}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (the most remote station)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {果|は}て: end, extremity — simpler and less dramatic
- ⟦{辺境|へんきょう}→辺境：14355_henkyou⟧: frontier, remote region — more factual, used in geography and history
- ⟦{僻地|へきち}→僻地：17059_hekichi⟧: remote area, backwater — can carry a negative connotation of underdevelopment
